segments.text: This VizieR metadata census asks which single tables intersect the abundance-search, mass-search, and redshift-search axes.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Show one VizieR single-table icon and T1 ENUMERATION stage label.
Reveal ABUNDANCE SEARCH metadata rail.
Reveal MASS SEARCH metadata rail.
Reveal REDSHIFT SEARCH metadata rail and merge all three into the single-table intersection.
Lock the persistent not-an-MZR and single-table/no-crossmatch badges.

segments.text: The search combined semantic UCD tags with column-name variants, and each frozen query returned exactly its pre-counted rows.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Reveal the SEMANTIC UCD TAGS rail.
Reveal the COLUMN-NAME VARIANTS rail beside it.
Join the rails and reveal FROZEN QUERIES.
Reveal ZERO CHANNEL FAILURES as a status badge.

segments.text: UCD plus name matching reached 5,568 tables on the abundance-search axis, 6,206 on mass-search, and 6,687 on redshift-search; name matching added 175, 88, and 20.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Reveal the ABUNDANCE SEARCH card with UCD and UCD-plus-name counts.
Reveal the MASS SEARCH card with UCD and UCD-plus-name counts.
Reveal the REDSHIFT SEARCH card with UCD and UCD-plus-name counts.
Reveal +175, +88, and +20 gains on a common baseline.
Lock COUNTS · AREA NOT ENCODED.

segments.text: The three axis lists intersected at 178 candidate tables.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Carry the three labeled search-axis rails forward.
Animate the three-list intersection.
Reveal 178 SINGLE TABLES.
Lock RECORDED METADATA CANDIDATES · NOT ELIGIBILITY RULINGS.

segments.text: Modifier columns then emptied a required axis in 21 tables: 19 on redshift and 2 on abundance, leaving 157 recorded candidates.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Start from the visible 178 node.
Branch −21 MODIFIER-FILTER DROPS from the main path.
Split the dropped branch into 19 REDSHIFT and 2 ABUNDANCE bins.
Reveal the recorded modifier examples under their bins.
Reveal 157 RECORDED CANDIDATE TABLES and keep its direct path to T2 visible.

segments.text: As a side check, a frozen term regex matched 62 of those 157 recorded descriptions; it is not an eligibility filter, and T2 still applies to all 157.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Show the direct 157-to-T2 path first.
Branch 62 OF 157 downward without interrupting the main path.
Reveal FROZEN VOCABULARY REGEX PRESENCE · NOT ADJUDICATED GAS-PHASE EVIDENCE.
Lock SIDE CHECK ONLY · T2 STILL APPLIES TO ALL 157.

segments.text: All seven pinned recall members returned, while none of the three controls appeared.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Reveal T1 RETRIEVAL-INSTRUMENT CHECK stage label.
Reveal RECALL 7/7 with seven checks.
Reveal CONTROLS APPEARING 0/3 with three absences.
Hold both scorecards on the same baseline.

segments.text: Those checks validate retrieval, not precision: the frozen controls did not cover the dominant precision-contamination mode.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Retain the 7/7 and 0/3 scorecards.
Reveal RETRIEVAL CHECK PASSED.
Reveal the contrasting PRECISION NOT CERTIFIED panel.
Reveal the frozen-control coverage limitation.
Open two empty characterization-group shells for the next beat.

segments.text: Recorded examples separate symbol-and-meaning collisions—Galactic height and model-grid metal fraction—from target-domain mismatches: stellar gravitational redshift and gravitational-redshift velocity. They are not T2 rulings.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Reveal T1 RECORDED CHARACTERIZATION · NOT T2 RULINGS.
Reveal SYMBOL / MEANING COLLISION.
Reveal Galactic height and model-grid metal fraction inside that group.
Reveal TARGET-DOMAIN MISMATCH.
Reveal the two gravitational-redshift examples and lock NOT T2 RULINGS.

segments.text: The T2 rule contract was frozen after seven gate rounds over twelve decoys and three anchors, but the 157-table eligibility application is not completed, so no eligible-table count or metallicity measurement is reportable yet.

timed_reveal_states.visible_change: Reveal REPORTABLE NOW with the frozen T1 facts and complete T2 contract-design control provenance.
Reveal PENDING with T2 application, eligible-table count, and any metallicity/MZR measurement.
Lock APPLICATION NOT COMPLETED · NO ELIGIBLE-TABLE COUNT across the direct 157-to-T2 gate.
Hold the combined qualified summary with SINGLE-TABLE METADATA CENSUS · NOT AN MZR MEASUREMENT.

integration_constraints: Visual card durations are floors; narration duration may expand a card but must not compress below the visual floor.
No worker-lane audio synthesis is authorized.
No narration may call 62 eligible or describe the census as an MZR measurement.
No narration may call abundance-search-, mass-search-, or redshift-search-axis metadata reach an adjudicated physical measurement.
T1 retrieval controls and T2 contract-design controls are distinct workflow stages and must remain labeled separately.
If T2 control counts are spoken or shown, include all 12 decoys plus 3 anchors and call them contract-design controls, not eligibility results.
Public release requires an audience-reachable methods and count ledger for internally derived denominators.
No substantive scientific evidence state may remain unchanged for more than four seconds; every substantive narration clause must trigger a visible reveal.
Do not create standalone section-divider holds; persist section identity with the evidence surface.
Reveal REPORTABLE NOW, then PENDING, then hold the combined qualified summary.
After mux, re-run hard-cut/evidence-state timing and sentence/action alignment on the exact candidate.
Use the final spoken script corresponding to the final Hwao storyboard, then run waveform and mux checks in the integrator lane.
Listening approval is a separate gate after synthesis and mux.
